digest.component_or_area: rebar project code-review criterion extension surface
propositions: Pass 1 must discover grounded candidate findings only and never assess validity, impact, severity, confidence, drop/block posture, or prescribe remediation; any such assessment in a Pass-1 instruction constitutes a finding
Pass 2 must answer atomic validity and impact questions only and never discover new findings, decide outcomes, or prescribe fixes; any such behavior in a Pass-2 instruction constitutes a finding
Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds and partition findings without an LLM; any LLM-based judgment or evidence-gathering in Pass-3 logic constitutes a finding

Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive next-move guidance only and never re-verify, alter decisions, or dictate exact implementations; any re-adjudication or precise instruction in Pass-4 coaching constitutes a finding

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion itself emits grounded evidence-only findings with no severity, confidence, or suggested_fix fields, routes with blocking_enabled=false and threshold 0.90, executes as single-turn 1-TURN against assembled diffs, and achieves perfect calibration (recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, stability_min>=2/3, kappa>=0.70) across all 12 balanced corpus cases in three independent runs

Project-owned implementation changes only .rebar/ routing/prompt/eval assets, .gitignore exceptions, criterion-specific tests, and docs/llm-framework.md Project dogfood subsection; no core kernel or generic seam modifications; landing is advisory and must not block active review flows
